summary: Phase 5 - Social Media Platform Integrations testing complete. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend page loads correctly with all 5 platform cards, connect/disconnect flows, publish dialog, and history tabs working. Fixed authentication bug in social_integrations.py (duplicate get_current_user function was returning mock user without auth check).

fixed_issues.issue: Duplicate get_current_user() function at line 199 was overriding the proper JWT auth function at line 39, allowing unauthenticated access
fixed_issues.fix: Removed duplicate placeholder get_current_user() function - now properly requires JWT authentication
